name: Andrew Croop

birth.place: Union (now Hunlock) Twp., Luzerne Co., PA

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Sophia, daughter of Joseph and Christine Bonham; six children, two living in 1893 (George M. and Maud).

events.title: Candidate for county jury commissioner
events.description: 'Andrew Croop, Hunlock' was listed among the Republican candidates for jury commissioner.

bioAdditions: Bradsby says Andrew, Hiram's brother, was a shoemaker by trade. In September 1866 he married Sophia Bonham, daughter of Joseph and Christine Bonham, and they had six children, two of whom (George M. and Maud) were living in 1893. In 1876 he moved from his father's farm to an 80-acre place of his own, and he ran a portable sawmill. He belonged to the G.A.R. and Jr. O.U.A.M. and served as school director for fifteen years, as well as secretary of the school board and township clerk (S1). In July 1900 he was a candidate for Luzerne County jury commissioner (S2).

relationships.evidence: Bradsby p.813: 'a brother to Hiram'; 'removed from his father's farm'

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Bradsby calls him Hiram's brother, and Hiram's parentage is stated; the service record is confirmed.

sources.citation: H. C. Bradsby, History of Luzerne County (1893), pp.584 and 812-813 (Hiram and Andrew Croop biographies)
